title_original: Inside the European Film Awards, plus Bond casting reaction - The Screen Podcast
excerpt_original: European Film Awards CEO Matthijs Wouter Knol shares his insights.

blocks.text: On this week’s episode of The Screen Podcast, we delve into the European Film Awards, which announced its nominations on Saturday (November 14).
First, host Wendy Mitchell speaks to editor Matt Mueller and Europe editor Tim Dams about the news that Robert Pattinson will be the next James Bond .

links.text: will be the next James Bond

blocks.text: Then, the trio discusses the nominations for the European Film Awards, which were led by Fatherland and La Bola Negra . The winners will be unveiled at the awards ceremony in Athens, Greece on January 16.
Finally, Mitchell is joined by European Film Academy CEO Matthijs Wouter Knol who offers insight into recent changes, the Academy’s relationship to the UK and its activities outside of awards season.
To download or subscribe to future episodes, search for ‘The Screen Podcast’, which is available on Apple Podcasts , Spotify , Acast and YouTube .
The Screen Podcast is produced by Ellie Calnan, with Wendy Mitchell serving as editorial director. New episodes every Thursday.
